questions.question: The bar graph given below shows the data of the production of paper (in lakh tonnes) by three different companies P, Q and R over the years. What is the percentage increase in the productivity company Q from 2010 to 2013 ?
questions.questionHtml:
The bar graph given below shows the data of the production of paper (in lakh tonnes) by three different companies P, Q and R over the years.

What is the percentage increase in the productivity company Q from 2010 to 2013 ?
questions.solution:
Given:

The productivity of company Q in 2010 is 30 lakh tones

The productivity of company Q in 2013 is 45 lakh tones

Concept used:

Percentage

Calculation:

Percentage increase = \(\frac{{45 - 30}}{{30}} \times 100\)

Percentage increase = \(\frac{{15}}{{30}} \times 100\)

∴ 100/2 = 50%

questions.question: The given histogram shows the height of the students. The number of students whose height is in the class interval 170-175 is what percent less than the number of students whose height is in the interval of 165-170? (correct to one decimal place)

Height (in cm)

Number of students

15

13

14

12

Calculation:

Number of students in the interval of 170-175 = 12

questions.questionHtml:

The number of cars with speed (km/h) in the interval (60 - 70) km/h is what percentage less than the number of cars with speed (km/h) in the interval (70 - 80) km/h? (correct to one decimal place)
questions.solution:

Speed Of Cars

(In Km/h)

Number of Cars

40 – 50

50

50 – 60

70

60 – 70

85

70 – 80

90

60

Calculation:

Number of Cars Between the Speed Interval of (60 - 70) Km/h = 85

questions.question: The given bar graph represents the passing percentage of 10 th and 12 th classes of a school during the consecutive four year period 2016-2019. What is the average passing percentage of the 10 th class for all four years if the number of students are same for all 4 years?
questions.questionHtml:
The given bar graph represents the passing percentage of 10th and 12th classes of a school during the consecutive four year period 2016-2019.

What is the average passing percentage of the 10th class for all four years if the number of students are same for all 4 years?
questions.solution:
Given :- 

Total number of years = 4

In 2016 percentage of pass student in class 10th = 52%

In 2017 percentage of pass student in class 10th = 60%

In 2018 percentage of pass student in class 10th = 72%

In 2019 percentage of pass student in class 10th = 71%

Concept :- 

Average = (Sum of all percentage of student pass)/(Total number of years)

Calculation :-

⇒ Average = (52% + 60% + 72% +71%)/4

⇒ Average = (255%)/4

⇒ Average of pass percentage of the 10th class for all four years = 63.75%

∴ Average of pass percentage of the 10th class for all four years = 63.75%
